title: Teeth
examples: What are the different types of teeth?
Why are my baby teeth different from my adult teeth?
What protects my teeth from getting cavities?

explain.say: Your teeth bite and chew your food. Chewing makes food small enough to swallow.
Look at the layers inside a tooth. Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
Your front teeth are called incisors. They cut food, like when you bite an apple.
Next to them are the canines. They are pointy and strong. They tear food.
Your back teeth are called molars. They are wide and flat. They grind food into small bits.
Your first teeth are milk teeth. Children have twenty of them. From about age six, they fall out and adult teeth grow.

draw.text: Milk teeth: 20. Adult teeth: up to 32.

explain.say: A hard white layer called enamel covers each tooth. Brush twice a day to keep it clean.

faq.q: Why do I have different types of teeth?
faq.a: Your teeth have different jobs to do. Incisors cut, canines tear, and molars grind food.
asks: What is the job of each tooth?
Why are there so many different teeth?

faq.q: Are my baby teeth the same as my adult teeth?
faq.a: No, they are different. Children have 20 milk teeth. Adults have up to 32 adult teeth.
asks: Will my baby teeth fall out?
When do I get grown-up teeth?

faq.q: What is enamel and why is it important?
faq.a: Enamel is a very hard outer coating on your teeth. It helps protect the softer parts underneath.
asks: What is the hard covering on my teeth?

faq.q: Do I need to brush my teeth twice a day?
faq.a: Yes, brushing twice a day keeps your teeth clean. It helps stop little holes called cavities.

faq.q: Can I eat sweets all the time?
faq.a: Sweets are a sometimes food. Sugar left on your teeth can make holes, so brush twice a day.
asks: Are sweets bad for my teeth?
What foods are best for teeth?

facts: Incisors are used for cutting food at the front.
Molars are the large back teeth used for grinding.
Milk teeth are temporary teeth that fall out.
Enamel is the hard outer layer protecting the tooth.

quiz.say: Think of tearing a bread roll. Tap the teeth that tear food.
quiz.why: Canines are pointy and strong. They tear food.

wrong.0: Incisors are the front teeth, and they cut food.
wrong.2: Molars are the flat back teeth, and they grind food.

quiz.say: Think of your wide, flat back teeth. Tap their main job.
quiz.why: Your back teeth are molars. They grind food into small bits.

wrong.1: Cutting is the job of the incisors at the front.
wrong.2: Tearing is the job of the pointy canines.

quiz.say: Think of brushing your teeth. Tap what brushing takes away.
quiz.why: Brushing takes away food bits and germs. This helps stop holes in your teeth.

wrong.0: Enamel is the hard outer layer, and brushing keeps it clean.
wrong.1: Milk teeth fall out by themselves when adult teeth grow.
